entities.description: Legacy measurement specification and wire protocol for AI operator telemetry. The SigRank Standard defined the original sigrank/0.1-draft protocol with four token primitives (input, output, cache_write, cache_read) and five derived metrics. It has been superseded by TTEOP (Token Telemetry Evaluation Operator Protocol) as the sole interoperability protocol authority per the owner-directed authority architecture baseline 2026-09-02. The wire protocol identifier sigrank/0.1-draft remains an accepted compatibility alias that resolves to current TTEOP semantics — it is not a second active standard. This entity is distinct from `sigrank` (the leaderboard) and exists to be the proper target of the TTEOP supersession edge.

entities.description: Open, vendor-neutral interoperability protocol for measuring AI operator token efficiency. TTEOP defines four non-negative integer telemetry primitives (input I, output O, cache write W, cache read R), five derived metrics (Yield, Leverage, Velocity, output_fraction, log_leverage), a telemetry envelope schema, privacy modes, provenance levels, conformance tests, and a governance process. TTEOP is the SOLE interoperability protocol authority for the token telemetry / AI operator measurement layer. Products (SignalAF, SigRank, Upsilon) implement TTEOP through version-pinned implementation profiles and may not redefine TTEOP semantics. The legacy predecessor sigrank-standard (sigrank/0.1-draft) is retained only for backward compatibility and migration evidence. Current protocol version: tteop/0.1-draft. GitHub repository name is otep-spec (historical, kept for URL stability); npm package is tteop-spec; protocol name is TTEOP. The MCP transport is tteop-mcp (transport class, does not define protocol semantics).
product_boundaries: TTEOP is the SOLE interoperability protocol authority for telemetry schemas, formulas, null semantics, privacy, provenance, and conformance.
Products implement TTEOP through version-pinned implementation profiles and may NOT redefine TTEOP I/O/W/R meaning, formulas, null semantics, privacy, or conformance.
sigrank-standard is a LEGACY PREDECESSOR, not a second active standard. Legacy alias sigrank/0.1-draft resolves to current TTEOP semantics.
tteop-mcp is a TRANSPORT. A transport bug may produce incorrect behavior but does not gain authority to redefine the protocol.
GitHub repo otep-spec, npm package tteop-spec, and protocol name TTEOP are ONE protocol authority. Do not treat them as separate standards.
